rootRuntimeReview.reason: 281 valid, distinct official cadastral polygons verified in thirteen local 0.001-degree cells around the unchanged WUP settlement locator. Complete pages, forced three-row pagination, all 281 fresh native cadastral-reference reads, valid synthetic absence, footprint and source binding passed. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32631 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Lille metropolitan settlement locator near Marcq-en-Barœul, which is a separate commune. The initial query restricted to Lille commune 59350 returned no parcel at the WUP point; the existing nationwide IGN provider verifies nearby ground at the unchanged locator without that municipal restriction. Wider municipal completeness, legal boundary accuracy and long-term identifier continuity remain unverified.
